Title: Biologics
Content: The newest drugs to treat deadly illnesses like cancer, autoimmune diseases, and heart disease are called biologics. Biologics are drugs that mimic naturally occurring proteins. These biologics are injected into patients. Doctors recently noticed that these drugs do not work for some patients. They developed the model below to explain why the drugs are ineffective in as many as `50%` of patients.
